items.title: Fresenius and WuXi team up in 37-strong biosimilar development deal
items.summary: The deal covers assets that target more than €370bn in originator sales.

items.title: Pelthos and Castle Creek plan merger to target skin diseases
items.summary: Pelthos Therapeutics has agreed to merge with Castle Creek Biosciences to form a new biotechnology company that will focus on serious diseases affecting the skin.

items.title: Inovio’s Voceryq receives FDA accelerated approval for RRP
items.summary: Inovio has secured accelerated approval from the FDA for Voceryq to minimise the frequency of surgery in adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP).

items.title: IDWeek 2026: early ensitrelvir PEP may benefit breakthrough and established Covid-19
items.summary: At IDWeek 2026, Akimasa Fukushi from Shionogi presented a subpopulation analysis of the Phase III SCORPIO-PEP trial.

items.title: IDWeek 2026: ISL/LEN on track to become the first once-weekly oral HIV therapy
items.summary: At IDWeek 2026, Samir K Gupta presented a pooled analysis of the Phase III ISLEND-1 and ISLEND-2 trials evaluating once-weekly ISL/LEN in adults with virologically suppressed HIV.
